title: The Block Tower
sentences: Nora wants to build a tall tower.
First, she puts down four big blocks.
Next, she adds three red blocks on top.
Then, she adds a small blue block.
Soon, the tower is as tall as Nora!
Her cat jumps on the table.
Oh no! The tower falls down.
Finally, Nora and her cat build it again.

options: She puts down four big blocks.

questions.prompt: What happens after the cat jumps on the table?
What do Nora and her cat do last?

bonus.prompt: Which word means about the same as last?
